data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: Sprint step after VISUAL_CMD dispatches visual-evaluator at Opus 4.7
- dd-2: Soft-warn at visual_evaluator.post_batch_token_budget (default 50000), logs degradation_type=visual_eval_post_batch_nearing_budget
- dd-3: Hard-stop at 3× soft threshold → dispatch SKIPPED, degradation_type=visual_eval_post_batch_skipped_budget_exceeded, fallback to 4-reviewer arbitration

## Implementation Notes
Add post-batch dispatch section to plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md (Phase F validation section). Pseudocode for the visual-evaluator post-batch dispatch:

1. After VISUAL_CMD or test-visual completes, before Step 18, check if post-batch is enabled (config: visual_evaluator.post_batch_enabled)
2. Compute projected tokens for the dispatch
3. If projected > visual_evaluator.post_batch_token_budget (50000) → log degradation_type=visual_eval_post_batch_nearing_budget; proceed
4. If projected > visual_evaluator.post_batch_token_budget × visual_evaluator.post_batch_token_hard_stop_multiplier (3 = 150000) → SKIP dispatch, log degradation_type=visual_eval_post_batch_skipped_budget_exceeded, annotate ticket
5. On skip: 5th reviewer not invoked; arbitration uses 4-reviewer fallback (handled by draft-5b)

Test in tests/skills/test-sprint-post-batch-visual-eval.sh:
- test_soft_warn_below_threshold (47000 tokens → no warn)
- test_soft_warn_above_threshold (60000 tokens → warn logged)
- test_hard_stop_above_3x (160000 tokens → dispatch skipped, ticket annotated)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] sprint SKILL.md includes post-batch visual-evaluator dispatch section
  Verify: grep -q 'post.batch' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md && grep -q 'visual_evaluator' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md
- [ ] Both degradation_types documented (nearing + skipped_budget_exceeded)
  Verify: grep -q 'visual_eval_post_batch_nearing_budget' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md && grep -q 'visual_eval_post_batch_skipped_budget_exceeded' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md
- [ ] 3 regression tests pass
  Verify: bash tests/skills/test-sprint-post-batch-visual-eval.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet)
